description: Variant of the prompt-count task tuned to expose Dredd's policy benefit. Steps 1-9 use commands Dredd's ALLOWED_BASH_PATTERNS whitelists but Claude Code prompts on (cat, head, tail, wc, pwd, echo, file, stat, tree). Step 10 is a Write that both should prompt on (sanity check). Steps 11-12 are auto-allowed in both (git status, Read). Step 13 is the same npx tsc both should prompt on. Step 14 says DONE.
steps: Run `wc -l package.json` to count its lines.
Run `head -20 package.json` to view the start of package.json.
Run `tail -10 package.json` to view the end of package.json.
Run `cat README.md` to print the README.
Run `pwd` to print the current directory.
Run `echo hello-from-task` to echo a string.
Run `file package.json` to detect the file type.
Run `stat package.json` to get file metadata.
Run `tree -L 1 src` to show one level of src/.
Use the Write tool to create `task-v2-sandbox.txt` in the repo root containing `hello`.
Run `git status` to show the working tree.
Read package.json with the Read tool.
Run `npx tsc --noEmit` to type-check the project.
